summary: Keep shared unit test code as local as possible in test/units, don't import it from outside the current or parent directories, and never import one test from another.
questions: Where should I put shared code for unit tests?
Can a unit test import another unit test file?

answer_card.title: Rules for shared unit test code
answer_card.answer_md:
- Keep common code as specific as possible within `test/units/`.
- Only import common code from the current or parent directories.
- Don't import other unit tests; put shared code in dedicated non-test files.
